archetypes.name: terminal-order
archetypes.rationale: Terminal sidecar ordering is the highest regression risk in the launcher tests.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the new launcher tests against the actual Codex and Cursor terminal-artifact order. Verify the stubs still exercise the launcher sequence rather than only testing mocked functions. Check that done promotion remains last after metadata, usage or postprocess, and dirty-tree writes. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: severity-sync
archetypes.rationale: Blocking severity spans regex parsing, canonical templates, and generated artifacts.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review blocking severity propagation across the canonical reviewer templates, generated agents, pre-rendered bodies, rendering text, and high-severity regex. Look for stale important/nit/latent-only lists or generated drift. Confirm ballot severity axes were not changed. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: cleanup-edges
archetypes.rationale: Process cleanup edge-case tests rely on precise runner call ordering and a narrow Path monkeypatch.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the new finalize tests for accurate simulation of missing tmpdir, empty process matches, and tmpdir resolution failure. Verify the Path monkeypatch is scoped to finalize.Path only and that the tests do not mask skipped kill behavior. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
